1 Prepare Engine Room Plant and Systems for start-up, including vessel utility systems sourced from ER.
2 Start and Monitor Engine Room Plant and Systems, including vessel utility systems sourced from ER.
3 Prepare and Shutdown Engine Room Plant and Systems, including vessel utility systems sourced from ER.
4 Isolate and reinstate Engine Room Plant and for Maintenance, including vessel utility systems sourced from ER.

  • Manage And Supervise Effectively:

1 Establish effective relationships with colleagues and subordinates.
2 Establish scope of work clearly (briefings, toolbox talks, presentations.)
3 Plan and control use of resources effectively. (Personnel, time, materials, transport, IT).
4 Use of communication skills shows leadership (oral, teambuilding, recording, noting, handover, analysing.
5 Objective and consistent in assessment of subordinates using competence assessment system.
6 Make recommendations and improvements in working practices for greater safety, efficiency and profitability.
7 Ensure all Maintenance (Routine and breakdown) is completed and recorded accurately and clearly
8 Ensure all plant and machinery complies with Class and Inspections

  • Contribute To Control Of Critical Situations And Respond To Emergencies:

1 Developing critical situations (operational, weather, equipment failure, leaks, fires personnel etc) are identified and logged for later analysis
2 Positive action is taken to limit escalation and to maintain control using applied policies or procedures or initiative
3 External agencies as appropriate are alerted in good time.

  • Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures:

1 Sample and check that controlled discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits
2 Identify and halt unplanned discharges where possible, and reported immediately according to policy, procedure and regulation.
3 Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure
4 Resources such as PPE materials tools and spares are not wasted or used inefficiently

  • Emergency Response:

1 Show competence during drills and exercises.
2 Carry Out Emergency Response Role
Qualifications And Experience

  • STCW Reg.III/2 Chief Engineer Unlimited Certificate (Steam and Motor endorsement preferred), (DCE for Petroleum/Gas as appropriate)
  • Experience as Chief Engineer on VLCC preferred and at least 2 yrs as 1st Engineer.
  • Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing and utility systems desirable.
  • Computer literate in Management System ‘Office’ software packages and experienced on maintenance management systems. Experience in Permit to Work Systems.
  • Medically fit to offshore International standards such as ENG1 or equivalent.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Rio de Janeiro, uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;

  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);

  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI)

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar!

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Sobre a Lemon: as mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. A Lemon existe para facilitar que empresas e pessoas impactem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de energia mais barata e limpa. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, oferecendo atendimento próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico. Somos apoiados por investidores globais em tecnologia e buscamos construir um time diverso com experiências e formações distintas para criar a nova era da energia limpa.

Sobre o time de tech: o time de Tecnologia da Lemon é o coração da nossa inovação e crescimento. Nossa tecnologia é criada e mantida por times multidisciplinares, responsáveis por desenvolver soluções escaláveis que impulsionam a nossa missão de revolucionar o setor de energia limpa. Trabalhamos em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde a criatividade e a excelência técnica são valorizadas. Usamos Google Cloud BigQuery como data warehouse e SQL para as transformações entre as camadas do nosso lakehouse, buscando governança e qualidade de dados alinhadas ao negócio. Estamos em constante evolução e esperamos que você contribua para isso também. Se você deseja fazer parte de uma equipe de ponta e contribuir para um futuro mais sustentável, a Lemon é o lugar certo para você.

O que você vai fazer

  • Ter a oportunidade de ajudar a transformar em unicórnio uma empresa com um dos maiores potenciais do mercado brasileiro;
  • Ajudar na remodelagem do ambiente analítico da empresa, sendo referência no uso de dados e traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções analíticas robustas;
  • Aumentar a confiabilidade dos insights baseados em dados com boas práticas de modelagem de dados em produtos de dados fundacionais e derivados;
  • Ser responsável pelas pipelines de transformação dos dados nas diferentes camadas do nosso ambiente analítico, garantindo a qualidade dos dados entregues;
  • Ser um dos pivôs no aculturamento da empresa em Governança, Qualidade e Confiabilidade de dados;
  • Apoiar e mentorar colegas em práticas de engenharia analítica, ajudando a elevar o nível técnico do time.

O perfil que buscamos

  • Profunda mentalidade de ownership, demonstrando forte responsabilidade pelo que constrói e mantém;
  • Comunicativo, responsivo e didático, com capacidade de traduzir construções técnicas em explicações tangíveis ao negócio;
  • Colaborativo e responsável, ajudando de forma proativa seus colegas sem prejudicar seus próprios compromissos;
  • Interessado pelo negócio e com vontade de entender suas regras, características e particularidades — queremos alguém que se envolva, entenda e questione;
  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade para colaborar em um ambiente de constante dinamismo. Somos uma startup e tomadas de decisão rápidas e assertivas fazem parte da nossa essência.

Experiência prévia / habilidades exigidas

  • SQL avançado (otimização, CTEs, window functions);
  • Fluência em metodologias de modelagem analítica de dados (Data Vault, Kimball, Star Schema etc.);
  • Conceitos como Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Data Lakehouse, Data Mesh;
  • Fundamentos de Data Quality e suas dimensões, frameworks e estratégias de implementação;
  • Noções de BigQuery (GCP) - experiência em boas práticas e performance;
  • Versionamento de código (Git) e boas práticas no uso de esteiras de produtização (CI/CD).

Será um diferencial se você já tiver conhecimentos em

  • Programação em Python;
  • Dataform ou dbt;
  • Experiência com pipelines de ingestão de APIs, webhooks e arquivos de diferentes formatos;
  • Experiência com tratamento de dados semiestruturados;
  • Experiência com orquestradores de dados (por exemplo, Airflow).

O que a gente oferece

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • Trabalho remoto;
  • Materiais de escritório;
  • Coworking em todo o país;
  • Cartão Caju flexível (utilizável nas categorias alimentação, refeição, mobilidade, educação, saúde e cultura);
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de saúde mental e bem-estar (Zenklub);
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Auxílio farmácia;
  • Lemon Feriados (dias de folga adicionais próximos a feriados).

Diversidade e inclusão

Aqui na Lemon a diversidade é um compromisso ético. Somos engajados em nos tornar uma empresa cada vez mais diversa e, se você se sentir confortável, gostaríamos de saber na candidatura se se identifica/declara pertencente a algum grupo de diversidade. Encorajamos candidaturas de pessoas com diferentes histórias e vivências para um ambiente mais inclusivo.

title: Commissioned Sales Representative - LATAM Region (Remote)
description:
About Monetize More

Monetize More is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients. This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.
  • Client Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers, understanding their needs and presenting tailored ad-tech solutions from Monetize More.
  • Sales Conversion: Drive the full sales cycle from initial outreach to closing deals, leveraging product demos, proposals, and negotiations to secure partnerships.
  • Market Representation: Represent MonetizeMore at industry conferences, webinars, and networking events, establishing the company as a trusted leader in ad-tech.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management and technical teams to ensure seamless onboarding and optimization for new clients.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Track sales performance using CRM tools, providing regular updates on pipeline progress and market insights to leadership.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on LATAM ad-tech trends, competitor offerings, and publisher needs to refine sales strategies.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
    • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics.
    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the APAC region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

Somos uma startup recifense focada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais inovadoras que geram impacto real no setor público. Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um Tech Lead para integrar nossa equipe. Seu papel será liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento do nosso produto de gerenciamento de atendimento (Service Management), construído sobre nossa plataforma low-code. O desafio é guiar o time na criação de uma solução robusta e escalável, promovendo inovação e excelência técnica.

Responsabilidades

  • Garantir o alinhamento técnico entre times e especialistas, assegurando coesão arquitetural e boas práticas.

  • Definir e documentar diretrizes arquiteturais, priorizando escalabilidade, eficiência e segurança.
  • Mentorar o time de desenvolvimento, incentivando boas práticas e a troca de conhecimento entre áreas.
  • Atuar como ponte entre desenvolvimento, produto e design, alinhando soluções técnicas aos objetivos estratégicos.
  • Planejar, delegar e acompanhar atividades, equilibrando prazos e qualidade.

Principais desafios

  • Evoluir nosso UI Builder: Participar da evolução do construtor de componentes e páginas, que permite criar telas e fluxos completos utilizando recursos do Vue.js por meio de interface, com alguns cliques e poucas linhas de código. Nosso objetivo é trazer a experiência de codar para o UI Builder, permitindo que até páginas mais complexas possam ser construídas nele.
  • Desenvolver nossa solução white label: Contribuir para a evolução do motor de criação de plataformas white label, que oferece funcionalidades nativas como autenticação, gerenciamento de usuários, permissões, construtor de formulários, CRUD de tabelas SQL via interface, CSM, entre outras. Tudo isso em um ambiente isolado para cada cliente, com possibilidade de customizações específicas.
  • Aprimorar nosso marketplace de páginas: Criar e expandir o marketplace que permite a publicação, instalação e gestão de páginas desenvolvidas em Vue, compartilháveis entre diferentes clientes do nosso ecossistema.
  • Expandir nossa biblioteca de componentes: Desenvolver componentes únicos e reutilizáveis, como formulários dinâmicos, calendários, gráficos Gantt, listas com integração nativa a APIs etc.
  • Desenvolver soluções de IA e Machine Learning: Criar fluxos com LLMs, integrando funções acionáveis em contextos específicos (como consultas em banco de dados). Implementar RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) por meio de vetorização de dados, buscas por similaridade e integração com LLM.
  • Automatizar com fluxos low-code/no-code: Implementar soluções usando ferramentas como N8N e ActivePieces, construindo fluxos e APIs completas via interface. Também criar novos nós reutilizáveis por toda a equipe de desenvolvimento.
  • Contribuir para o open source: Apoiar a abertura dos nossos produtos para a comunidade, fomentando colaboração global e ampliando o impacto das soluções.

  • Horários flexíveis, com foco em resultados.

Por que trabalhar na Beyond?

  • Impacto positivo real: Nossos produtos transformam áreas como educação, saúde e direito.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

We are looking for talented professionals to join our Regional Operations team at 99Food ! If you have a start-up spirit and are always looking to create value, you would be a great fit for this team!

As part of Regional Operations , selected candidates will play a key role in driving city growth, improving marketplace performance, and shaping local strategies that connect users, restaurants, and couriers. This role requires a hands-on approach, strong problem-solving skills, and a proactive mindset to identify opportunities for growth, efficiency, and differentiation.

The ideal candidates will engage directly with restaurant partners, customers, and business development teams to understand the dynamics of each city. They will analyze local performance data, gather on-the-ground perspectives, and translate insights into actionable strategies that strengthen 99Food’s position in each market and ensure long-term sustainable growth.

In this role, you\'ll be...

As a Strategy & Operations Senior Analyst at 99Food, you will be responsible for monitoring and analyzing the performance of our marketplace, growth campaigns, and communication initiatives . Your role is critical in ensuring that strategies are not only well-designed but also effectively executed and continuously optimized.

You will take ownership of building and maintaining performance dashboards, identifying key trends, and uncovering improvement opportunities across cities. By translating data into actionable insights, you will support decision-making and help guide campaign strategy, restaurant engagement, and customer growth.

This position requires a professional who is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and structured , with strong communication skills to collaborate across Operations, Marketing, CRM, Product, and BD teams. You will act as the bridge between strategy and execution , ensuring that every initiative is measured, tracked, and improved to maximize its impact.

Your work will directly contribute to shaping how 99Food grows and strengthens its position in competitive markets, driving both short-term results and long-term expansion .

    • Fluency in Portuguese and English; Mandarin is a strong plus.

You\'ll love working at DiDi because...

We are data-driven. We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration. Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone\'s best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity. Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth. We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion. Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

Docusign brings agreements to life. About Monetize More

Monetize More is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients. This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.
  • Client Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers, understanding their needs and presenting tailored ad-tech solutions from Monetize More.
  • Sales Conversion: Drive the full sales cycle from initial outreach to closing deals, leveraging product demos, proposals, and negotiations to secure partnerships.
  • Market Representation: Represent MonetizeMore at industry conferences, webinars, and networking events, establishing the company as a trusted leader in ad-tech.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management and technical teams to ensure seamless onboarding and optimization for new clients.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Track sales performance using CRM tools, providing regular updates on pipeline progress and market insights to leadership.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on LATAM ad-tech trends, competitor offerings, and publisher needs to refine sales strategies.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
    • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics.
    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the APAC region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

Our shared vision is to improve life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

Our satellites acquire images of Earth at any time—cloudy or dark conditions included—providing commercial and government partners with unmatched persistent monitoring capabilities. Data derived from our SAR images assists customers in making data-driven decisions to address time-critical challenges across sectors such as maritime, disaster management, insurance, and finance.

Our team comprises experts across disciplines like engineering, software development, and radar technology. We are innovative, driven, and strive for excellence. Core values include teamwork, curiosity, and having fun, which help us make the impossible possible!

Why work with us?

ICEYE is at the forefront of new technology, continuously building and operating our commercial SAR satellite constellation. Joining ICEYE means contributing to industry-shaping innovations while working with diverse, engaged colleagues. We value our people highly, offering opportunities to influence the company's vision and direction.

We support continuous professional development through courses, training, and conference attendance. At ICEYE, your growth and success are priorities.

What will you do in this role?

  • Collaborate with the Senior Manager of Latin America to develop regional strategies, including identifying the best routes for ICEYE's services (federal, state, or local levels), and expanding key client accounts long-term.

  • Support and develop proposals for government prospects alongside the Senior Manager Latin America.

A ATS (Amazon Transportation Services) está procurando por pessoas motivadas para ajudar a desenvolver um processo logístico de classe mundial que entregue mercadorias no prazo e com o melhor custo. O objetivo da nossa equipe é gerenciar com excelência a execução do frete que flui através de nossas redes de transporte, focada especificamente no gerenciamento, desenvolvimento, qualidade e desempenho de transportadoras.
Esse papel exige por uma pessoa ambiciosa. Você representará uma função crítica em nossas operações de transporte mais amplas na Amazon, enquanto trabalhamos para melhorar continuamente os níveis de serviço, prezando pela segurança em nossas instalações. Isso nos ajudará a garantir que as promessas feitas aos nossos valiosos clientes sejam cumpridas sempre.
Uma pessoa especialista em operações de transporte facilita o fluxo de informações entre diferentes partes interessadas (transportadoras/hubs/armazéns) e resolve quaisquer possíveis problemas que afetem a experiência do cliente e a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, trabalhará em operações externas com relacionamento Sort Center/Carrier, garantindo que o caminhão saia do SC para entregar os pedidos dos clientes conforme a promessa. Essa pessoa também monitora a chegada da nossa frota e aborda quaisquer possíveis problemas que ocorram durante o ciclo de vida do frete saindo do FC/SC e chegando às instalações do cliente.
Como especialista em transporte, você deve ser capaz de solucionar o problema em tempo hábil pesquisando e consultando ferramentas internas e tomando decisões em tempo real. Você deve ser capaz de entender os requisitos/ser capaz de analisar dados e observar tendências e ser capaz de impulsionar a experiência do cliente sem comprometer o tempo. Ter o conhecimento básico de Logística e deve ser capaz de se comunicar claramente na forma escrita e oral, também é necessário. A pessoa deve ser capaz de idealizar melhorias no processo e ter o zelo de levá-las à conclusão.
Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não só celebramos a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, mas também as diversas formas de trabalhar. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para o processo de entrevista ou integração, informe nossa equipe e nós o conectaremos à nossa equipe de acomodação.
Essa função funcionará em turnos 3x2 das 18h às 5h
Key job responsibilities
Comunicação com clientes externos (transportadoras, fornecedores/fornecedores) e clientes internos (varejo, finanças, suporte de software, centros de atendimento, estações de entrega, centros de classificação).
Capacidade de extrair dados de vários bancos de dados (usando Excel, Access, SQL e/ou outros sistemas de gerenciamento de dados) e realizar relatórios e análises ad hoc conforme necessário é uma vantagem.
Desenvolver e/ou compreender métricas de desempenho para ajudar a impulsionar os resultados comerciais.
Deve ser capaz de entender rapidamente o impacto comercial das tendências e tomar decisões que façam sentido com base nos dados disponíveis.
Deve ser capaz de encaminhar sistematicamente problemas ou variações nas informações e dados para os proprietários e equipes relevantes e cumprir as resoluções para garantir que sejam entregues.
Trabalhe dentro de várias restrições de tempo para atender às necessidades críticas dos negócios, ao mesmo tempo em que mede e identifica as atividades realizadas.
Excelente comunicação, tanto verbal quanto escrita, para criar uma narrativa descrevendo as descobertas semanais e as variações das metas, e apresentá-las em um fórum de revisão.
Suporta o monitoramento da chegada de veículos, correta alocação de veículos no horário necessário para carregamento, nas docas corretas, respeitando todos os padrões de segurança Amazon.
Responder às atividades de agendamento de veículos.
Prioriza-define a alocação dos veículos em doca.
A day in the life
O Ops Lead é o principal ponto de contato de transportes dentro de um centro de distribuição/ sort center. Ele(a) será o guardião de segurança e qualidade em todas as movimentações de Inbound e Outbound dentro das instalações Amazon. Garantirá a execução da rotina e a exelência nos resultados das métricas. Analisará qualquer desvio, mesmo que pequeno, para evitar problemas de qualidade e segurança. Escalará pontenciais riscos de atendimento para a liderança, e garantirá o fluxo de entrada e saída de veículos sem gargalos.

Monetize More is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the LATAM region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients. This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.
  • Client Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers, understanding their needs and presenting tailored ad-tech solutions from Monetize More.
  • Sales Conversion: Drive the full sales cycle from initial outreach to closing deals, leveraging product demos, proposals, and negotiations to secure partnerships.
  • Market Representation: Represent MonetizeMore at industry conferences, webinars, and networking events, establishing the company as a trusted leader in ad-tech.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management and technical teams to ensure seamless onboarding and optimization for new clients.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Track sales performance using CRM tools, providing regular updates on pipeline progress and market insights to leadership.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on LATAM ad-tech trends, competitor offerings, and publisher needs to refine sales strategies.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
    • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics.
    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the LATAM region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

title: Engineering Manager - Security Standards and Hardening
description:
Overview

Engineering Manager - Security Standards and Hardening at Canonical. The role leads security standards for open source software across the Ubuntu platform, including desktops, servers, edge devices, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes and OpenStack. You will work on cryptographic modules (FIPS 140) and system hardening, partnering with CIS and DISA to define and build secure deployments. You will drive security excellence for millions of users and influence development teams and external partners.

Canonical is committed to delivering the world\'s best open source platform and upholding high standards for software security across the ecosystem. Ubuntu is a leading platform for large-scale cloud and edge deployments, and the role involves helping customers meet security requirements such as FIPS, CIS, STIG, FedRAMP and the CRA.

What you will do

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers across levels from graduate to senior
  • Coach, mentor, and provide career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise strong engineering and organizational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Support products and customers to meet strict product security requirements (FIPS, CIS, STIG, FedRAMP, CRA)
  • Contribute to cryptography modules (FIPS 140) and system hardening efforts with industry partners (CIS, DISA)
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure secure deployments

What we are looking for

  • Strong academic track record from high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling alternative path
  • Driven with a track record of going above and beyond
  • Excellent verbal and written communication in English
  • Experience in developing people and growing teams
  • Organised with the ability to deliver timely, high-quality results
  • Professional interactions with colleagues, partners, and the community
  • Experience with FIPS/Common Criteria certified products and knowledge of underlying standards
  • Experience with DISA-STIG or CIS benchmarks and related audit/remediation tooling (e.g., Compliance as Code)
  • Strong interest in software and application security
  • Experience in an agile development environment
  • Demonstrated continuous learning mindset
  • Ability to build trust and relationships, and to drive results
  • Willingness to travel twice a year for company events (up to two weeks per trip)

Optional qualifications

  • Hands-on knowledge of Linux cryptography libraries (OpenSSL, GnuTLS) or similar domain experience

What we offer

Canonical offers compensation based on geography, experience, and performance, with annual reviews and a performance-driven bonus. We provide a comprehensive benefits package and support global fairness in compensation.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly in-person team sprints
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunities to travel to meet colleagues
  • Travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech company and the publisher of Ubuntu. We recruit globally and uphold high standards, with a remote-first approach since 2004. We value excellence and continuous learning. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer.

Overview

Welcome to TELUS Digital, where innovation meets impact. We are an award-winning digital product consultancy shaping the future of digital experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture. Location and Flexibility

This role can be fully remote for candidates based in Brazil, due to team distribution and occasional in-person opportunities. If you are based in São Paulo or Porto Alegre, you are welcome to work from one of our offices on a flexible schedule.

The Opportunity

As a Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer on our team, you'll design, develop, and deliver machine learning solutions, decipher loosely defined problems using complex datasets, and determine appropriate analytical and modeling techniques. You'll analyze structured and unstructured data, establish automated processes for large-scale modeling, perform exploratory analysis, and collaborate with peers on data acquisition and exploration, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership and urgency.

Responsibilities

  • Work on all aspects of the design, development and delivery of machine learning enabled solutions for our clients;
  • Come up with solutions to loosely defined business problems by leveraging pattern detection over complex datasets across multiple platforms;
  • Establish efficient, automated processes for large-scale modeling;
  • Become part of a highly skilled and geographically distributed team;
  • Collaborate with peers on problem definitions, data acquisition, data exploration, visualization as well as building the tools that support this process;
  • Strong sense of ownership, urgency and drive.

Qualifications

  • Relevant experience in data science/ machine learning development.
  • Bachelor and/or Master degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or other related subject.
  • Proficiency in Python.
  • Experience with machine learning frameworks (like Keras, TensorFlow, or PyTorch) and libraries (like scikit-learn).
  • Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms, processes, tools and platforms.
  • Ability to work on distributed cloud platforms

Bonus Points

  • Experience with container management and machine learning deployment frameworks, such as Kubernetes, Kubeflow and MLFlow.
  • Software development experience from scoping, requirements design, development, integration, testing, go live to PROD (vs internal research work)

Why TELUS Digital?

At TELUS Digital, you'll work with world-class brands like FOX, HBO, PepsiCo, and Domino's, building transformative digital products that impact millions. Our global reach allows you to collaborate with diverse, international teams, solving complex problems and delivering tech-driven solutions that matter. We thrive on engineering excellence, using the latest technologies in cloud computing, AI, machine learning, DevOps, microservices architecture, and data engineering. Our teams embrace Agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and a DevOps-first mindset to deliver solutions at scale.

In addition to being part of an international and innovative consultancy company, you will have:

  • A Global Innovation Hub: Be part of an international consultancy at the forefront of technology
  • Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy flexible hours and autonomy to balance your professional and personal life
  • Cutting-Edge Tech Playground: Dive into the latest technologies and shape the future of digital solutions
  • Prestigious Partnerships: Collaborate with world-renowned brands, making a real impact in the market
  • Growth-Centric Environment: Thrive in our collaborative ecosystem with a clear career development path
  • Global Exposure: Embrace optional international travel opportunities to broaden your horizons

Some of our benefits:

  • Health and dental plan
  • Life insurance
  • Monthly voucher for meals, culture, education, health and mobility
  • Child care assistance and more!

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are committed to building an inclusive team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Therefore we provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or disability.

We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since our inception, we have grown to be a team of over 3,000 employees in 35 countries around the world. We own over 400 global technical patents and a network that includes over 525,000 points of retail distribution that points to our industry expertise.

We are significantly growing our Engineering and IT teams in Brazil and are focused on finding talent for various financial technology (Fintech) engineering, database, development, and testing teams.

InComm Payments is highly focused on our people and their growth, and we work hard to make a career at InComm Payments meaningful and rewarding. We value innovation, quality, passion, integrity and responsibility in all that we do, and we are looking for great people to join our team as we move forward towards a very bright future. We anticipate developing future leaders for our teams in Brazil!

Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses! All positions are CLT.

You can learn more about InComm Payments by visiting our Website or connecting with us on LinkedIn, YouTube, Twitter, Facebook, or Instagram.

About This Opportunity

As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), you’ll support teams across both Waterfall and Agile teams by delivering robust automated testing solutions. You’ll help define and maintain quality strategies, validation methods, and best practices across development, testing, UAT, and production environments to ensure consistent and reliable software delivery.

CLT and fully remote position. Must reside in Brazil. Benefits include:

  • Health and dental insurance
  • Meal and restaurant vouchers
  • Fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses
  • Company-issued device (hardware and software)
  • Annual bonuses

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Java, Python, or tool-specific languages
  • Automate regression, integration, and functional test cases following best practices
  • Balance manual vs. automated testing efforts to optimize coverage
  • Participate in code reviews and design discussions to improve product quality
  • Collaborate across Dev, QA, and product teams in a multi-tiered environment
  • Estimate testing efforts and timelines for sprint and project deliverables
  • Coordinate with third-party teams to ensure quality and timely delivery
  • Write and maintain QA documentation and standards
  • Optimize SQL queries and analyze automation script issues
  • Report defects with clear documentation and track quality risks
  • Support production implementations during off-hours maintenance windows
  • Monitor results against technical specs and distribute findings to stakeholders

Qualifications

  • Associate Degree, or, Technologo (Technologist) Degree, or higher is required.
  • 3+ years of experience in test automation using Python and Java
  • Hands-on with automation testing tools: Postman, Robot, SoapUI, RestAssured, Playwright, DevTest (LISA), Locust
  • Strong background in white-box and black-box testing in multi-tiered environments
  • Experience with test frameworks like JUnit
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools: GitHub, Jenkins, ArgoCD
  • Basic understanding of Kubernetes and containerized apps (preferred)
  • Proven ability to define and maintain QA strategies, policies, and documentation
  • Proficient in IDEs like Eclipse and IntelliJ

description:
Overview

Somos o Grupo Energisa! Com mais de cem anos de história, a Energisa é o maior grupo privado com controle 100% nacional do setor elétrico brasileiro. Nosso portfólio abrange distribuidoras, concessões de transmissão, geração de grande porte renovável, uma marca inovadora de soluções energéticas – a (re)energisa –, com geração distribuída por fonte renovável, comercialização de energia no mercado livre e serviços de valor agregado, além de uma central de serviços compartilhados, uma empresa de contact center e a fintech Voltz, a primeira do nosso setor no mercado de contas digitais. Recentemente, diversificamos nosso portfólio com a inclusão da distribuição de gás natural, através da aquisição da ES Gás. Transformamos, através de nossos mais de 17.000 colaboradores, energia em conforto e desenvolvimento para mais de 20 milhões de pessoas. Acreditamos na força da diversidade e da pluralidade para gerar inovação e atingir resultados incríveis. Aqui todos são muito bem-vindos! Quer fazer parte desta história? Confere se esta oportunidade tem match com o seu perfil e vem conosco participar desta jornada de seleção!

Responsibilities

  • Gerenciar os recursos e o orçamento da área de arquitetura de TI, assegurando que os projetos e iniciativas sejam executados de forma eficiente e dentro dos limites financeiros estabelecidos.
  • Estabelecer e manter padrões e diretrizes para garantir consistência e qualidade na arquitetura de sistemas, incluindo práticas de design, integração e segurança.
  • Colaborar com as áreas de negócio para garantir que a arquitetura de TI atenda às necessidades de todos os departamentos e seja integrada de forma eficaz.

  • Formação: Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas
  • Capacidade de projetar arquiteturas robustas e escaláveis para ambientes on-premises, em nuvem e híbridos, integrando sistemas, APIs e microsserviços.
  • Planejamento estratégico e desenvolvimento de um roadmap tecnológico alinhado aos objetivos de negócios, garantindo que a arquitetura de TI suporte o crescimento e a inovação organizacional.
  • Habilidade em planejar, executar e avaliar provas de conceito e provas de valor para validar soluções e tecnologias antes da implementação em larga escala.
  • Conhecimento avançado em plataformas de computação em nuvem, com foco em computação, armazenamento, redes e serviços de integração.
  • Experiência em práticas de segurança para proteger dados, sistemas, redes e APIs, incluindo criptografia, gestão de identidade e acesso, autenticação multifator e conformidade com regulamentos.
  • Conhecimento em implementar e gerenciar soluções de monitoramento e observabilidade, assegurando visibilidade do desempenho e da saúde dos sistemas.
  • Experiência em integração de sistemas por meio de APIs e práticas de governança, garantindo interoperabilidade entre plataformas.
  • Capacidade de projetar soluções resilientes e escaláveis, com arquiteturas de alta disponibilidade e práticas de recuperação de desastres.
  • Habilidade em desenvolver e manter plataformas internas de desenvolvedores que permitam autoatendimento para provisionamento de recursos e implementação de soluções.
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas baseadas em eventos e microsserviços, garantindo escalabilidade e interoperabilidade entre sistemas distribuídos.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de governança de dados, proteção de dados e conformidade com regulamentos de privacidade e normas de segurança.
  • Habilidade em projetar e gerenciar fluxos de dados otimizados para suportar grandes volumes de dados, aprendizado de máquina e inteligência artificial.
  • Capacidade de liderar e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, coordenando desenvolvedores, engenheiros e stakeholders para garantir que as soluções atendam às expectativas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Interesse em se manter atualizado com as últimas tendências em tecnologias, frameworks e práticas de arquitetura, buscando continuamente aprimorar soluções e arquiteturas.

Inovação, credibilidade e foco no cliente definem o nosso DNA. Buscamos incessantemente a qualidade no fornecimento de energia e a excelência no atendimento, garantindo conforto, segurança e bem-estar para os nossos consumidores.

Com mais de cem anos de atuação, estamos presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil: 862 municípios nos estados da Paraíba, Sergipe, Tocantins, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Paraná, Acre e Rondônia. description:
Se você gosta de trabalhar com o público, tem boa comunicação, é organizado (a), tem o sentimento de dono e responsabilidade essa vaga é para você.

O Promotor de Merchandising é na linha de frente com os nossos clientes representando a Coty e fazendo com que os nossos produtos estejam sempre disponíveis para os nossos consumidores.

Responsabilidades

  • Reposição de mercadoria
  • Organização do layout
  • Conquista e montagem de pontos extras
  • Manuseio de ferramentas de controle via celular
  • Facilidade com aplicativos via celular
  • Habilidade com trabalho em equipe e negociação
  • Boa comunicação
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar de segunda à sábado
  • Vaga para todos os estados do Brasil

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde
  • Vale Alimentação e Refeição
  • 40% de desconto nos produtos Coty

Sobre a Coty

Fundada em Paris em 1904, a Coty é uma das maiores empresas de beleza do mundo. Com portfólio de marcas consagradas em fragrâncias, maquiagens e esmaltes, cuidados com pele e corpo, a empresa atende clientes em todo o mundo e está presente em cerca de 130 países. A Coty e as suas marcas estimulam o empoderamento das pessoas para que se expressem livresmente, criando suas próprias visões de beleza; além de serem comprometidas em fomentar positivo impacto no planeta.

No Brasil, o Grupo Coty conta com aproximadamente 2,4 mil funcionários alocados em suas empresas, localizadas no Estado de São Paulo (área de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento e sede administrativa); no Estado de Goiás (fábrica Savoy e o principal centro de distribuição); e no Estado do Rio de Janeiro (centro de distribuição).

Localmente, fabricamos e comercializamos milhões de produtos todos os anos, de nossas tradicionais marcas brasileiras - como Risqué, Monange, Bozzano, Paixão, Cenoura & Bronze e outras muito conhecidas pelos brasileiros. Além disso, também comercializamos nossas fragrâncias internacionais, licenciadas de famosas marcas (Calvin Klein, Lacoste, Hugo Boss, Chloé, Burberry, Gucci, Tiffany, entre outras); e produtos de maquiagem e skincare, com Kylie Cosmetics e Kylie Skin.

Na Coty, acreditamos que hoje ninguém pode controlar ou deve ditar o que é ou não bonito. Estamos em busca de uma nova era de beleza - uma em que, juntos, a cocriamos de maneira que você possa se expressar da forma que desejar. Como companhia dessa indústria, nosso propósito é viabilizar, conjuntamente, todas as visões de beleza.

O conceito de beleza não é fixo; é algo fluido, como a água – em constante evolução e adaptação. Não é singular, e sim plural. É hora de desconstruir todos os conceitos de beleza.

Tornamos ‘fearless kindness’ ( sem medo de ser gentil, gentileza destemida ) a base dos nossos valores, porque sabemos que agora, mais do que nunca, o mundo precisa de gentileza. É um atributo e uma ação que tem um efeito de ondulação que irradia muito - gentileza para consigo mesmo, gentileza para com os outros e gentileza para com o planeta.

Portanto, hoje e todos os dias, junte-se a nós para fazer da ‘fearless kindness’ a base para suas decisões e ações; juntos, vamos causar impacto positivo no nosso próprio bem-estar mental e daqueles que nos rodeiam.

Queremos PROFISSIONAIS DIVERSOS no nosso time!

Acreditamos que vivências diferentes tornam o time vencedor. Por isso, nossas oportunidades são para todos, independentemente de raça, religião, cor, nacionalidade, idade, gênero, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, estado civil ou qualquer outra característica. Ou seja, valorizamos exatamente quem VOCÊ é!

title: Diretor De Operações
description:
A Brunel está em busca de um Diretor de Operações (Perfuração) para integrar o time de um de seus maiores clientes no setor de Petróleo e Gás no Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

Como Diretor de Operações de Perfuração, você será responsável por supervisionar todo o planejamento e a execução de campanhas de perfuração, garantindo segurança, conformidade regulatória, eficiência operacional e alinhamento com as expectativas da empresa e clientes.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar todo o ciclo das operações de perfuração, desde o planejamento do poço e mobilização da sonda até a execução e análise pós-operação.
  • Gerenciar contratados de perfuração e prestadores de serviço, assegurando o cumprimento dos padrões técnicos e de segurança.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de controle de custos para otimizar os orçamentos de perfuração (CAPEX/OPEX).
  • Supervisionar a seleção de sondas e garantir conformidade com as regras de aceitação de sondas da Petrobras e os requisitos do RASMA.
  • Manter rigorosa conformidade com as normas da ANP e as NRs (Normas Regulamentadoras) brasileiras relacionadas à segurança, meio ambiente e saúde ocupacional.
  • Coordenar a preparação técnica e a documentação para auditorias e inspeções da Petrobras.
  • Identificar, documentar e liderar o encerramento de itens de não conformidade (Categorias A, B e C), conforme a classificação da Petrobras.
  • Atuar como elo principal entre as partes interessadas internas e órgãos reguladores (ANP, Petrobras, IBAMA, etc.).
  • Monitorar e reportar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs), incluindo ROP, NPT e prazos de entrega de poços.
  • Promover uma cultura orientada para a segurança por meio de programas proativos de SMS, investigações de incidentes e gestão de riscos.

Conformidade e Regulação

description:
Overview

Nisga'a CIOPS provides hands-on experienced services to civilian and DoD programs worldwide. Delivering highly skilled, cleared personnel who provide services on five continents for a portfolio of customers.

Summary

The Contract Specialist will provide acquisition support services to the Federal Bureau of Prisons. Each Contract Specialist shall have full authority to act for the contractor on all acquisition matters related to the daily operations of this resulting contract.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions

  • Work independently with little oversight by the Government.
  • Provide advice and recommendations for all elements in acquisition plans, including approaches, options, strategies, risks, contracting methods, competition, sources, cost, milestone schedules, etc.
  • Research existing Government-wide contracts for available products and services. Evaluate different approaches to and sources for OS services support. Research available suppliers and compare the services and costs of obtaining support from different providers.
  • Assist in the preparation of Independent Government Cost Estimates. Research analysis may include, but is not limited to, past purchases of the products or services, the current market value of the products or services, and other agency purchases of similar products or services.
  • Conduct market research to identify potential sources and contract vehicles. Potential sources should include socio-economic program participants (i.e. small businesses, small and disadvantaged businesses, HUB Zone businesses). Potential vehicles should include GSA vendors, Government-wide Agency contracts, and other agency contracts.
  • Conduct market surveys and prepare written documentation of market research.
  • Support the preparation of any and all of the following OA approved acquisition package documents.
  • Responsible for coordination/communication with program office personnel (SME's and COR's) during all phases of the initial acquisition processes and to coordinate/communicate during all phases of the initial acquisition with assigned Office of Acquisition Contracting Specialists (CS) and Contracting Officers (CO).
  • Support the creation of solicitations and amendments contract writing system. Ensure documents are uploaded into electronic filing system, eFile.
  • Support and provide professional opinion and business advice regarding selection of procurement methods and contract type.
  • Support negotiations, including the documentation of negotiation objectives and negotiation outcomes via the creation of Award Determination Memorandums.
  • Support the creation of award documents, modifications, and supporting documentation.
  • Support the Contracting Officer via responding to data calls, providing status updates, participating in meetings and conference calls with customers, and providing general administrative support directly related to acquisition functions/matters.

Qualifications

Necessary Skills and Knowledge

  • Possesses demonstrated expertise in and capability to perform full range of contract actions including solicitations, contract awards, modifications, negotiations, incorporation of changes, exercise of options, price analysis, and resolution of contract issues.
  • Possesses demonstrated knowledge of the Procurement Administrative Lead Time (PALT)Possesses demonstrated expertise in and capability to support proposal evaluations including price/cost analysis or technical proposal analysis in the Federal sector.
  • Possesses a clear understanding of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR)
  • Possesses demonstrated negotiation and interpersonal skills.
  • Possesses demonstrated experience utilizing contracting writing systems.
  • Possesses demonstrated expertise in and capability to perform contract administration support services, including assistance with reviewing contractor performance, developing contract modifications, and investigating reports of contract discrepancies: contract closeout.
  • Possesses demonstrated expertise in and capability to perform document creation in support of the above actions, including Determination and Findings, Market Research Reports, Pre and Post Negotiation Memorandum/Award
  • Memorandum, Acquisition Plans, Sole Source Justifications, and other documents common to the acquisition process
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited educational institution and a minimum of five (5) to eight (8) years of experience in contracting providing service to Federal clients. Or at least 24 semester hours in any combination of the following fields: accounting, business, finance, law, contracts, purchasing, economics or management.
  • MUST have previous Bureau of Prisons (BOP) experience.
  • Minimum five (5) years of experience in contracting providing service to Federal clients.
  • Experienced, skilled, and knowledgeable in all aspects of Federal Government acquisition (i.e. requirements development, budgeting and acquisition planning, market research, development of independent cost estimates.)
  • Must be able to obtain/maintain a Public Trust level clearance.
  • Must have the ability to pass a drug test if requested.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in a related field.
  • Experience in contract writing system Unified Financial Management (UFMS) preferred.
  • Active Secret clearance preferred.
  • 2 to 4 years of experience supporting Federal Customers (Department of Justice, DOJ highly preferred).

Pay and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $90,000 to $130,000 per year.

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. As an employee, you\'ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, tax-deferred savings options, supplementary benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

title: Data Engineering Manager
description:
Overview

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the globalHotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

About Your Team

At Teachable, our Data team aims to support company data-driven decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Data, you lead our Data Engineering team and partner closely with product and business teams, making strategic technical decisions.

About You

You have a background experience with modern data architectures and engineering tools, are comfortable in supporting the design and optimization of data pipelines, modeling databases, and are constantly seeking ways to enhance data reliability, scalability, and the value delivered to stakeholders.

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage and mentor a team of data engineers, besides define the team’s mission, direction, and strategy in alignment with the Data team and business goals.
  • Lead large-scale technical projects and cross-team initiatives and guide technical leads in making impactful architectural and data modeling decisions.
  • Represent the Data Engineering team across the company and act as a strong partner to technology and business stakeholders.
  • Balance build vs. buy decisions to maximize impact and efficiency in product analytics and infrastructure.
  • Manage technical debt while ensuring scalability, reliability and maintainability.
  • Work with product and business teams, balancing technical depth with strategic impact.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Proven track record managing technical teams, including technical leads and managers.
  • A problem-solving mindset, attention to detail, and a drive to make processes more efficient.
  • Strong experience with AWS cloud infrastructure (MWAA, RDS, S3, IAM permissioning model).
  • Strong experience with orchestration/workflow tools (e.g.: Airflow).
  • Understanding of infrastructure as code (Terraform).
  • Knowledge of batch and streaming frameworks (e.g.: Kafka, Kinesis, Spark Streaming).
  • Good communication skills, fluent English proficiency and ability to operate in an international environment.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with AWS DMS, MKS, SQS/SNS, AppFlow, Data Build Tool (DBT).
  • Understanding of Data Mesh or domain-driven data architectures.
  • Familiarity with metadata management and data catalog tools.

This is a fully remote role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Preferably candidates based on Belo Horizonte or São Paulo. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time, and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we are committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: ABX Strategist
description:
Overview

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

Role and Responsibilities

  • As an ABX Strategist at Power Digital, you’ll be the hands-on driver of our account-based execution programs. You’ll own ABM platform and DSP campaign management, build and refine ICPs, create client-ready presentations, and support go-to-market strategy development. You’ll partner closely with strategy leads and Marketing Ops to turn ideas into action, ensuring campaigns are properly routed, tracked, and reported in CRM/automation systems while bringing discipline, documentation, and results to every engagement. Beyond ABX, you’ll flex into broader strategic projects such as persona development, GTM planning, and competitive audits, delivering work with speed, polish, and precision. This role is built for an execution-first, client-facing operator who thrives in an agency environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage end-to-end ABM platform and DSP campaigns: setup, optimization, reporting, and flawless execution.
  • Support ABX programs, including but not limited to ICP pulls, TAL development, account scoring models, sales-marketing alignment, and account-level targeting
  • Build audience strategies and deliver cross-channel orchestration plans
  • Develop client-ready presentations, reports, and strategic recommendations
  • Document and standardize processes, ensuring repeatable, scalable best practices
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance campaign execution, segmentation, and reporting
  • Leverage Power Digital’s Nova ecosystem to maximize performance and alignment
  • Partner with Marketing Ops (MOPs) to ensure campaigns are properly routed, tracked, and reported in CRM/automation systems
  • Work closely with the Paid Media team to share ABM/DSP expertise, train on best practices, and ensure alignment across programs
  • Support broader strategic projects such as GTM planning, persona/ICP development, and competitive audits with research and executional inputs
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on ABM platform or DSP campaign management experience (agency or in-house)
  • Proven executional expertise in at least one ABM platform (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks) and one DSP (e.g., The Trade Desk, StackAdapt)
  • Strong data and audience segmentation skills, with the ability to connect targeting logic to outcomes.
  • Exceptional PowerPoint and presentation design skills; your work is always client-ready
  • Comfort working directly with clients, explaining campaign logic, and presenting results
  • Strong documentation and process orientation; you proactively build runbooks and guides
  • Effective collaborator across Strategy, Content, and Ops teams
  • Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo) to QA, document, and align ABX program data
  • Comfortable flexing across strategic projects — from audience pulls to GTM research to content audits — with a “roll up your sleeves” approach

Ideal Tech Stack: 6sense, Demandbase, Intensify, LinkedIn Ads, TradeDesk, RollWorks, Clay, Salesforce, HubSpot, Meta Ads.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Campaign Efficiency – Improve cost-per-engaged account and return on ad spend (ROAS) for ABM/DSP campaigns, measured by % improvement against a client’s baseline.
  • Account Engagement & Progression – Drive ICP account movement through the ABX funnel, tracked as % of accounts reaching defined engagement tiers and velocity of stage progression.
  • Campaign Launch & Documentation – Ensure 100% on time campaign execution, with KPIs including average turnaround time, % of campaigns launched, and strategy documentation to support.
  • Quality of Client Deliverables - Deliver 100% of presentations, decks, and reports on or before agreed deadlines, with fewer than 10% requiring major revisions each month, as measured through internal review and client feedback.
  • Internal & Client Satisfaction - Participate in 100% of scheduled client meetings held on time and documented with clear agendas and recaps, as well as prepare and share client information internally a minimum of 24 hours ahead of client calls

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Flawless ABM/DSP campaign execution — campaigns run smoothly, on time, and optimized for results
  • Process-first mindset — you proactively document workflows and build scalable systems
  • Polished, client-ready delivery — every presentation and output meets the highest standard

Diversity and Equal Opportunity

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees\' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.
